status: reviewed by Jeff Campbell 2026-10-24; open questions pending

routes.name: Home-based vendor
routes.buyers: End consumers only; not for resale

allowed_foods.rule: Non-TCS foods only (no time/temperature control needed for safety)
examples: Breads, bagels, scones, sourdough, quick breads
Cupcakes and cakes with commercially prepared shelf-stable frosting or a lab-tested recipe
Jams and jellies from high-acid fruit, full-sugar
Tree nuts, legumes, roasted coffee beans

prohibited_foods: Dairy products other than commercial dairy used as an ingredient
restricted_needs_testing: Cream cheese frosting (contact local health department)

sales_channels.in_person: Farmers markets, roadside stands, events that permit HBVs
sales_channels.phone_online: Allowed; label must also be shown on the vendor's web page
sales_channels.delivery: May ship or deliver from home within Indiana: in person, mail, or carrier, tamper-evident packaging
sales_channels.consignment: Only if the vendor is present at the time of sale

routes.record_keeping: Keep each end consumer's shipping or delivery address for at least 1 year
routes.packaging: Sealed, tamper-evident packaging for shipped products

label.statement: This product is home produced and processed and the production area has not been inspected by the state department of health.
label.notes: Exact statement wording to be confirmed against IC 16-42-5.3 text

training.type: Food handler certificate from an ANSI-accredited issuer

routes.inspections: Only after a complaint or suspected health hazard
routes.local_rules: Local units may not require licensing, certification, or inspection; zoning may apply

routes.name: Homestead vendor
routes.where_food_is_made: Own property: primary residence or agricultural land, owned or leased

allowed_foods.rule: Listed categories only, primarily derived from the property; app policy: no foods that need refrigeration (non-TCS only)
examples: Prepared foods and baked goods (some subject to federal rules)
Meat raised on the property and processed under IC 15-17-5

prohibited_foods: Foods that need refrigeration (app policy), e.g. cheesecake, cream and custard pies

sales_channels.in_person: From the property or at a farmers market
sales_channels.phone_online: Orders by phone or online from Indiana buyers (app policy)
sales_channels.delivery: May ship or deliver from home within Indiana, sealed packages; food handler certificate required to ship or deliver

routes.packaging: Package on the property before transport; no cutting, serving, reheating, or repackaging after

label.statement: This product was produced by a homestead vendor or the owner of a small farm that is exempt from government licensing and inspection.
label.unpackaged_items: A sign may replace a label

training.type: Food handler certificate from an ANSI-accredited issuer

routes.inspections: Only after a foodborne illness complaint
routes.local_rules: State and local agencies may not be more restrictive than the law; farmers markets may set their own rules

llc.note: Forms, fees and ongoing reports change; the app links to the state's office rather than listing them. See rules/llc-basics.json for what bakers typically need.

sources.title: IDOH guidance on homestead and small farm food sales (2026-05-26)

rules: No foods that need refrigeration on either route
Sales to buyers in Indiana only
Bakers may ship or deliver from home within Indiana
